Subject: Intro/demo request — Redwood inference

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — Jordan and I are excited to see Redwood in action. Can we schedule a 45-minute demo next week? Our preferred slot is Thursday 2026-03-18 at 11:00 AM PT. Main goals: see latency/cost controls, quick walk-through of the console, and discussion about onboarding (S3 access, sample data ingestion).

If that slot doesn't work, any availability later that week or early the following week should be fine. We can also share a small sample dataset beforehand if helpful.

Appreciate it —
Alex Riley
Director, Platform Engineering
Fintech Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@fintechinc.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — Redwood inference

Hi Alex — thanks for the proposed slot and the requirements doc. Quick note: we have a travel conflict for the original date and, more importantly, we'd like to request a slightly later demo window so our SE can prep with your sample prompts/workload traces. To give you the best hands-on run (and to ensure we can surface quantization/batching recommendations), would you be open to moving to one of these options:

- Monday 2026-03-22, 11:00 AM PT (preferred)
- Tuesday 2026-03-23, 9:30 AM PT

Prep ask from our side (items that will materially improve the session):
- A small sample of production-like queries/prompts (5–10 examples)
- A workload trace or token distribution (last 7 days or representative sample)
- A CSV of representative records (PII can be redacted) or a link to a staging bucket we can read
- Any existing latency/cost expectations you want us to prioritize

If you can upload the sample files to the Drive link below or send them to me directly, our SE (cc'd) will use them to build a short demo script and a couple of prompts to validate throughput. I'll attach a short prompt_examples.md with the patterns we usually test.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-prep

Thanks — can you confirm which of the proposed new times works? If neither, tell me two alternate slots and we'll do our best.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: prompt_examples.md (markdown, 8KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Intro/demo request — Prep items for Fintech Inc. demo (DEAL-13247)

Hi team — forwarding Alex's request and the samples they said they'd provide. They indicated 3/18 originally but I've asked to move to 3/22 so we have time to do a rehearsal. Can you help with the following before the client upload finishes?

1) Confirm we have a staging environment with S3 read access for "fintech-inc-demo" and that I can generate a short-lived token for their bucket. If not, I'll coordinate with infra.
2) Can you prepare a quick workload analysis on the attached workload_trace_20260314.json once they upload it (I asked them to drop a trace) and give me a 1-page summary of token distribution + hot prompts?
3) If we want to highlight batching/caching wins, any reference config you recommend for ~2k qps-ish bursts?

Timing: client likely to drop data by EOD 3/16. Would love a rehearsal 30–45 minutes on 3/21.

Thanks — Marissa

[Attachment stub: workload_trace_20260314.json (json, 1.2MB) — pending client upload]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-16T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Intro/demo request — Prep items for Fintech Inc. demo (DEAL-13247)

Got it — happy to own the prep. Quick notes and asklist: 

- Staging access: we have a demo bucket (s3://redwood-staging/fintech-inc-demo). I'll generate a temporary role that grants read-only via AWS STS; Marissa, I'll share the ARN/token once the bucket is populated.
- Workload trace: once we have the trace file I'll run the token histogram + latency simulators and post a 1-page summary into the Drive link. Expect that by EOD 3/17 if they upload on 3/16.
- Reference config: for a bursty workload (~2k qps) I'd demo: a dynamic batching window of 8–12ms, KV cache configured with a 5 minute TTL, and the quantization profile we'll use (int8 with per-channel). I'll include the CLI snippet in the rehearsal doc.

I can make time for a rehearsal on 3/21 at 10:30 AM PT or 3/21 at 3:00 PM PT — prefer morning. If client confirms 3/22 11:00 AM PT, a 3/21 10:30 AM PT rehearsal works for me.

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
